text_block_list.text:
Glory, glory, ho! ♪ Good morning,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
You bet I am! You know why? It's
because I had
the most wonderful
dream!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I dreamed that I was with Shiraoki on
Mount Fuji
eating eggplant and
watching the hawks fly!
That's all the
ingredients needed for the most

powerful soup for the soul!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I'm well rested, well
chuffed, and,
well, just happy to be
here!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I think Shiraoki must have instilled me
with the
power to do my best! ♪
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I think a good night's sleep probably
played more
of a role than divine
intervention... but either
way, I'm glad
she's rested.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
